question: Which of the following Acts was passed by the British Parliament, defining the powers and responsibilities of the various organs of the East India Company?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Regulating Act of 1773.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• On May 1, 1707, **the English** and Scottish Parliaments passed the **Acts of Union**, which resulted in the formation of the United Kingdom of Great Britain. In October 1707, the UK Parliament convened for the first time.
 
• The **East India Company Act of 1772,** also known as the Regulating Act of 1773, was an Act of the British Parliament designed to reorganize the East India Company's administration of its rule in India. It represented the first step toward centralized administration in India and legislative oversight of the Company.
 
• Therefore, the answer is **Regulating Act of 1773.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Indian Councils Act of 1892:

 
 
• ​The British Parliament passed the **Indian Councils Act of 1892**, which expanded the size of India's legislative councils.
 
• The ability to** inquire about the budget** was also granted to the members. 
 
• It marked the start of **India's transition to a representative system** of government.
 
 
 
• Pitt's India Act (1784):
 
 
• ​The dual system of authority by the British government and the East India Company was founded by **Pitt's India Act (1784)**, named after British prime **minister William Pitt** the Younger.
 
• The Regulating Act of 1773 needed to be fixed, therefore the British Parliament passed the Pitt's India Act, 1784, also known as the **East India Company Act, 1784. **
 
 
 
• Government of India Act 1858:
 
 
• ​The **East India Company's territory** and authority were handed to the British Crown by the **Government of India Act 1858**, an act of the British parliament.
 
• The British East India Company, which up until this moment had been in charge of British India under the auspices of Parliament, was to be liquidated in accordance with its terms, and its **duties were to be transferred to the British Crown**.
